description: [Kyreos, 0.005 USDC via x402] Live DNS check of any domain: DMARC policy, SPF with recursive lookup count against the RFC 7208 limit of 10, DKIM probed at 10 common selectors (custom selectors may be missed), MX. Returns a 0-100 score, issues, and the exact next DMARC record to publish, keeping sp, ruf and fo. For agents that send mail as a domain. Input: {"domain":"example.com"}. Call once to get the payment terms; call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call

name: kyreos_dmarc_audit_tool
